briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 race toward multi-agent AGI benchmarks

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases amid intensifying global competition. Compute constraints and safety gaps remain primary bottlenecks. Regulatory pressure mounts in US and EU.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deploys o4 with enhanced reasoning chains. Anthropic releases Claude 4 Opus. Meta open-sources Llama 4 while xAI ships Grok-3. DeepSeek unveils V3 with record efficiency.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA ships Blackwell Ultra clusters to Microsoft and Oracle. TSMC ramps 2nm AI chip production. New hyperscale data centers announced in Texas and Arizona.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first 10^26 FLOP training run trigger an intelligence explosion before 2028?
